children: Jiemian News reported that JD's instant-delivery service has upgraded its instant retail supply and will launch the iPhone 18 Pro series simultaneously through more than 7,000 Apple authorized specialty stores and over 10,000 front warehouses, with delivery as fast as 9 minutes. The move follows Apple's product launch event held in the early hours of September 10, when the iPhone Duo, the iPhone 18 Pro series and Apple Watch Ultra 4 were unveiled.

title: JD Instant Delivery to Offer iPhone 18 Pro Series From Over 7,000 Apple Stores and 10,000 Warehouses
